## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Commodity-led reflation: BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND and UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND driving cyclicals. Credit/stress signals neutral: HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.18% | 1M: -1.14%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall; TLT (1W: -0.10% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND points to modest bond weakness while dollar measures are flat per risk matrix. Net: conditions marginally tighter but not decisive.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND; Financials mixed: XLF (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +4.04%) CORRECTION. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US markets drift: SPY (1W: -0.95% | 1M: +0.41%) CORRECTION. China showing strength: FXI (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +4.13%) ABOVE TREND while broad EM EEM (1W: -1.46% | 1M: -7.29%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Crypto risk-on via IBIT (1W: +4.74% | 1M: +1.46%) ABOVE TREND contrasts with weakness in thematic risk ARKK (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -4.51%) BELOW TREND and small caps IWM (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION — selective speculation.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity rally led by oil and grains: UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: +1.27% | 1M: -0.57%) RECOVERY. Precious metals mixed: GLD (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -5.40%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -15.89%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND and broad oil ETFs ABOVE TREND; natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed pockets: XLE (ABOVE TREND) and FXI (ABOVE TREND) show genuine momentum; VXX RECOVERY (1W up, 1M down) and multiple sector CORRECTIONS (CIBR, XBI, XLV, XLF) signal minor divergences across sectors. No major divergence across core ETFs, so regime remains NEUTRAL.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to commodity/energy and select EM China via FXI given clear ABOVE TREND readings; reduce exposure to large-cap tech (XLK BELOW TREND) and thematic semis (SOXX BELOW TREND). Bonds neutral-to-weak as TLT BELOW TREND but HYG marginally ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.11% | 1M: +6.75%) ABOVE TREND — watch cyclical follow-through. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -3.07% | 1M: -5.32%) BELOW TREND — watch continued tech underperformance.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +13.41%) ABOVE TREND and UGA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +20.44%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -15.89%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) — current RECOVERY action matters; HYG/LQD near parity (credit health) — HYG (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: +0.18% | 1M: -1.14%) RECOVERY; watch XLK/XLF spread for style pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive, mixed ETF signals (VXX neutral, SPY_TLT neutral) support a non-directional stance. Energy (XLE) and China (FXI) showing strength while Tech (XLK) and thematic semis show weakness — monitor sector CORRECTIONS for confirmation.
